reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs support it: p0084 obliges Sparkling (Customer) only to pay Fee Schedule fees, p0118 allows Customer termination on 90 days' notice with no termination fee or remaining-value payment, and p0128 directs money flows to the Customer on Vendor default (perpetual licence plus refund).
No Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty or minimum/early-termination charge appears in the cited text, so the clause set meets the preferred position rather than merely the fallback.
Consistent with a compliant finding, the redline is identical to the original paragraphs and no counterparty comment was proposed; no deterministic check failures were raised.
Rationale is accurate and correctly notes that value flowing to our party is not flaggable.
